text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert: AUTH-SIGNING-P1 fired for service=auth-signing-prod, urgency=high, triggered by surge in token-verify failures (gateway -> 502/5xx). Auto-page to oncall.

pagerduty: Incident #PD-83421: Alert routed to Alice K (primary). Please acknowledge.

Alice K (oncall): acked. jumping in — seeing a spike in token-verify errors in the last 60s. grabbing logs.

Alice K (oncall): quick summary from initial look: multiple signature verification failures with error "signature verification failed: kid not found" and increased verifier latency (~800-1200ms). Not a complete outage but elevated 5xx for auth endpoints.

Carla M (auth-eng): on it. checking jwks sync and signer health. no recent deploys to signing service in the last 2 hours per deploy-bot.

Alice K (oncall): support, can you open an incident banner for affected customers? likely SSO and token validation flows.

Dave (support): @Alice K will draft a short customer note & add to status page. asking for impact numbers to include.

Carla M (auth-eng): running quick check against JWKS endpoint: `curl -s https://jwks.internal.redwood/api/keys | jq '.keys | length'` returns 1 right now, expected 3. that's suspicious. looking at signer pods.

Bob S (sre): checking infra — host-level metrics for signer nodes look normal, CPU/GPU not saturated. network flaps? not obvious.

Carla M (auth-eng): logs from signer show repeated warnings: `WARN signer: published key set missing kid=K_2026_07` and `ERROR verifier: key_lookup_timeout` around the same time. appears the key rotation job failed halfway, leaving verifier with a stale keyset.

Alice K (oncall): can we temporarily point verifiers to the previous stable JWKS URL or fall back to legacy verifier? want to minimize customer impact while we restore keyset.

Carla M (auth-eng): yes. I'll flip verifiers to read from mirror endpoint that still has the older keys: `/jwks/mirror`. rolling config change now — applying canary to 10% of verifier pods.

Alice K (oncall): patching config: `kubectl set env deployment/verifier -n prod JWKS_URL=https://jwks-mirror.internal.redwood/jwks` (canary 10%).

Bob S (sre): can confirm canary sees drop in signature fails. metrics: verifier_fail_rate canary -> 0.5% (was 12%). good sign.

Carla M (auth-eng): rolling to 100% now. also restarting key-rotation CronJob; investigating why it exited with nonzero. grabbing cronjob logs.

incident-bot: Note: on-call handoff scheduled in 30m to @Bob S. Use `#incidents` for updates and `#eng-oncall` for deep dive.

Dave (support): posted status: "Partial authentication failures (token validation) affecting a subset of API requests. Mitigation in progress — rolling to backup JWKS. Next update in 15 minutes." :information_source:

Megan (product): @Alice can you include customer-impact estimate? we need to notify top two enterprise customers proactively if >10% of auth traffic impacted.

Alice K (oncall): current impact: ~11-13% auth traffic seeing 401/5xx for 10-12 minutes before canary. Post-failover it's down to ~0.8%. will escalate to customers.

Carla M (auth-eng): root cause: key-rotation job failed to push the new keyset to the primary JWKS cache due to a transient permission error when writing to storage (403). Fix: re-run rotation job with corrected IAM token, and add a retry + alert on partial keyset publication.

Alice K (oncall): mitigation complete — verifiers on mirror restored full traffic. continuing to monitor. setting severity P1 until full root cause and postmortem assigned.

Bob S (sre): I'll take postmortem owner for infra-side action items (monitoring alert for partial key publication).

Carla M (auth-eng): I'll own auth-side postmortem — will add fix to rotation job, add preflight check to ensure full keyset present before switching active kid.

Alice K (oncall): handing incident to Bob S for next 30m oncall period — Bob, please pick up final wrap (RCAs, confirm IAM fix, and customer followups).

Bob S (sre): acknowledged. I'll coordinate with Carla and Dave for customer comms and follow-ups.

incident-bot: Incident PD-83421 acknowledged by Alice K. Escalation path: if signers still failing after 30m escalate to eng leads.

Alice K (oncall): final note before handoff: timeline + mitigation summary for postmortem: 00:00 alert fired, 00:02 ack, 00:04 identify missing keys, 00:08 canary mirror switch, 00:12 full switch, 00:14 success confirmed. saving logs and metrics to /incidents/PD-83421/artifacts.

Dave (support): customer notice queued. will push to status page and send targeted emails to the two affected enterprise accounts.

Megan (product): thanks all. please add action item to postmortem to improve alert messaging (differentiate partial key publication vs signer crash).

Alice K (oncall): closing on-call shift now, leaving incident in Bob's hands. good job team. :tada:
